local function GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, key, level, overrides)
    if overrides and overrides[key] ~= nil then
        return tonumber(overrides[key])
    end
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end
    local raw
    if item_kv.AbilityValues and item_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv.AbilityValues, key, level)
    else
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(raw)
end

local function SetOverride(overrides, key, raw, level)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, key, raw, level, base_value)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function ResolveSourceKey(name, hero_name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack") and hero_name and hero_name ~= "" then
        return hero_name .. "_" .. name
    end
    return name
end

local function CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)
    local slots = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return slots
    end

    local base = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", level)
    if base and base ~= "" and base ~= "none" then
        table.insert(slots, { name = base, context = "Projectile" })
    end

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        if item_kv[key] == nil and i > 2 then
            -- stop scanning once we are past the default slots and no explicit key exists
            if i > 3 then
                break
            end
        end
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(slots, { name = val, context = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix })
        end
    end

    return slots
end

local function CollectItemSources(item_kv, level)
    local list = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return list
    end

    local hero = item_kv.HeroName
    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)) do
        local src = ResolveSourceKey(slot.name, hero)
        if src and src ~= "" and src ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, src)
        end
    end

    local function push(key)
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, val)
        end
    end

    push("PassiveName")
    push("PassiveSP")
    push("PassiveSP2")
    for i = 3, 6 do
        push("PassiveSP" .. tostring(i))
    end
    push("AbilitySP")
    push("ModifierSP")

    return list
end

local function GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if not cfg then
        return nil
    end
    local targets = NormalizeList(cfg.Projectile)
    if #targets == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    for i, name in ipairs(targets) do
        if tostring(name) == tostring(projectile_name) then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, level, context, projectile_name, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    local idx = GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if idx == nil then
        return
    end

    local function set_value(prefix, raw)
        SetOverride(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level)
    end

    local function set_number(prefix, raw)
        local base_value = GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, prefix, item_level, overrides)
        SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level, base_value)
    end

    if context == "Projectile" then
        set_value("ProjectileName", cfg.Projectile)
        set_number("ProjectileInterval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number("ProjectileRange", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number("ProjectileBaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value("HealPercent", cfg.HealPercent)
        set_value("PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    else
        local suffix = string.sub(context, string.len("ProjectileSP") + 1)
        local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        set_value(prefix, cfg.Projectile)
        set_number(prefix .. "Interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number(prefix .. "Range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number(prefix .. "BaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value(prefix .. "PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    end
end

local function IsEmptyValue(value)
    return value == nil or value == "" or value == "none" or value == "0"
end

local function GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if not IsEmptyValue(val) then
            highest = i
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local next_idx = math.max(3, GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides) + 1)
    local suffix = (next_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(next_idx)
    return "ProjectileSP" .. suffix, next_idx
end

local function GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "PassiveSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if IsEmptyValue(val) then
            return key
        end
    end
    return "PassiveSP3"
end

local function ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, level, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg or not item_kv then
        return
    end

    local additional_list = NormalizeList(cfg.AdditionalProjectile)
    for i, name in ipairs(additional_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key, slot_idx = GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            local suffix = (slot_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(slot_idx)

            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, i
),
                level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Interval",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Range",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "BaseDamage",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "PurePercent",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalPurePercent, i), level)
        end
    end

    local passive_list = NormalizeList(cfg.Passive)
    for i, name in ipairs(passive_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key = GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.PassiveLevel, i), level)
        end
    end

    local ability_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.AbilitySP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(ability_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "AbilitySP", ability_sp, level)
    end

    local modifier_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.ModifierSP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(modifier_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "ModifierSP", modifier_sp, level)
    end

    SetOverride(overrides, "LifestealSP", GetListValueAt(cfg.LifestealSP, 1), level)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhanceKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"]
    end
    return kv
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV()
    return kv and kv[name] or nil
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildSourceIndex()
    self.source_index = {}
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV() or {}
    for name, cfg in pairs(kv) do
        local sources = NormalizeList(cfg and cfg.Source)
        for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
            local key = tostring(src)
            if key ~= "" then
                self.source_index[key] = self.source_index[key] or {}
                table.insert(self.source_index[key], name)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)
    if not source_key or source_key == "" then
        return {}
    end
    return self.source_index[source_key] or {}
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return 1
    end
    local stacks = tonumber(cfg.Stacks or 1) or 1
    if stacks == -1 then
        return -1
    end
    if stacks < 1 then
        stacks = 1
    end
    return stacks
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return false
    end
    return tonumber(cfg.Open or 0) == 1
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources)
    if not item_sources or not cfg_sources then
        return false
    end
    for _, src in ipairs(cfg_sources) do
        local target = tostring(src)
        if target ~= "" then
            for _, item_src in ipairs(item_sources) do
                if tostring(item_src) == target then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:EnsureState(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return nil
    end
    if not self.states[pid] then
        self.states[pid] = {
            pool_list = {},
            pool_map = {},
            purchased = {},
            selection = nil,
        }
    end
    return self.states[pid]
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true

    self:BuildSourceIndex()

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_request", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_choice", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    end)

end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:InitPlayer(pid)
    self:EnsureState(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return 0
    end
    return state.purchased[name] or 0
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SetPurchasedCount(pid, name, count)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    state.purchased[name] = count
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name)
    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
        return false
    end

    if state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return false
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if stacks ~= -1 then
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        if purchased >= stacks then
            return false
        end
    end

    table.insert(state.pool_list, name)
    state.pool_map[name] = true
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, source_key)
    local changed = false
    for _, name in ipairs(self:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name) or changed
    end
    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return false
    end
    if not state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end
    state.pool_map[name] = nil

    for i = #state.pool_list, 1, -1 do
        if state.pool_list[i] == name then
            table.remove(state.pool_list, i)
            break
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPoolList(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state then
        return {}
    end
    return state.pool_list
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsUnlocked(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return true
    end
    if not SpawnWallManager or not SpawnWallManager.GetExpansionProgress then
        return true
    end
    local _, _, count = SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    count = tonumber(count or 0) or 0
    return count >= 5
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    local pool_count = (state and state.pool_list and #state.pool_list) or 0
    return {
        unlocked = self:IsUnlocked(pid),
        available = pool_count > 0,
        pool_count = pool_count,
    }
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(pid, raw_item_name, level)
    if not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end

    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name]
    if not kv then
        return false
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local changed = false
    for _, src in ipairs(CollectItemSources(kv, lvl)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, src) or changed
    end

    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, raw_item_name, level, kv)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not raw_item_name then
        return nil
    end

    local item_kv = kv or (Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name])
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local item_sources = CollectItemSources(item_kv, lvl)
    local overrides = {}
    local applied = false
    local applied_extra = {}

    for enhance_name, count in pairs(state.purchased or {}) do
        if count and count > 0 then
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
            if self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
                local cfg_sources = NormalizeList(cfg.Source)
                if self:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources) then
                    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
                    local enhance_level = (stacks == -1) and count or math.min(count, stacks)
                    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, lvl)) do
                        ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, slot.context, slot.name, item_kv, lvl)
                    end
                    if not applied_extra[enhance_name] then
                        ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, item_kv, lvl)
                        applied_extra[enhance_name] = true
                    end
                    applied = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not applied then
        return nil
    end

    return overrides
end

local function BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level)
    local vars = {}
    if not cfg then
        return vars
    end

    local function set_var(key, raw)
        local val = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if val ~= nil and val ~= "" then
            vars[key] = val
        end
    end

    set_var("interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
    set_var("range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
    set_var("damage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)

    local add_name = GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectile, 1)
    if add_name and add_name ~= "" and add_name ~= "none" then
        vars["additional_projectile"] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(add_name)
    end
    set_var("additional_projectile_level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, 1))
    set_var("additional_projectile_interval", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, 1))
    set_var("additional_projectile_range", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, 1))
    set_var("additional_projectile_damage", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, 1))

    local passive_name = GetListValueAt(cfg.Passive, 1)
    if passive_name and passive_name ~= "" and passive_name ~= "none" then
        vars["passive_name"] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(passive_name)
    end

    return vars
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name) or {}
    local level = 1
    if pid then
        local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        level = purchased + 1
        if stacks ~= -1 then
            level = math.min(level, stacks)
        end
        if level < 1 then
            level = 1
        end
    end

    local payload = {
        ability = name or "",
        image = cfg.Image or "",
        display_name = cfg.Name or "",
        display_desc = cfg.Desc or cfg.Description or "",
        display_desc_vars = BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level),
    }

    if payload.image == "" and name and name ~= "" then
        payload.image = "s2r://panorama/images/spellicons/" .. name .. "_png.vtex"
    end

    return payload
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    if not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or state.selection then
        return
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return
    end

    local temp_pool = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(pool) do
        temp_pool[i] = name
    end

    local choices = {}
    local count = self.config.choice_count or 3

    for i = 1, count do
        if #temp_pool > 0 then
            local idx = RandomInt(1, #temp_pool)
            local name = temp_pool[idx]
            choices[i] = name
            table.remove(temp_pool, idx)
        else
            choices[i] = nil
        end
    end

    state.selection = {
        choices = choices,
    }

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if player then
        local payload = {
            player_id = pid,
            choice_count = count,
            title = "#shop1_enhance_pick_title",
            choices = {},
        }

        for i = 1, count do
            local name = choices[i]
            if name and name ~= "" then
                payload.choices[i] = self:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
            else
                payload.choices[i] = {
                    ability = "",
                    image = "s2r://panorama/images/hero_selection/empty_hero_card_png.vtex",
                }
            end
        end

        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_show", payload)
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ClearSelection(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if state then
        state.selection = nil
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SendClose(pid)
    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end
    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_close", {
        player_id = pid,
    })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    self:StartSelection(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    local idx = tonumber(event.choice_index or -1)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not state.selection then
        return
    end

    if idx < 1 then
        return
    end

    local choice = state.selection.choices and state.selection.choices[idx]
    if not choice or choice == "" then
        return
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(choice)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        self:ClearSelection(pid)
        return
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, choice) + 1
    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased > stacks then
        purchased = stacks
    end
    self:SetPurchasedCount(pid, choice, purchased)

    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased >= stacks then
        self:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, choice)
    end

    -- Unlock derived enhances chained by Source
    self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, choice)

    self:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)

    self:ClearSelection(pid)
    self:SendClose(pid)
end


function Shop1EnhanceManager:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.RefreshItemsForEnhance then
        return
    end

    mgr:RefreshItemsForEnhance()

    if mgr.SyncToClient then
        mgr:SyncToClient()
    end
end

**Refining enhancement description handling and localization**

I’m updating various scripts to properly handle enhancement descriptions by implementing logic that respects three DescType categories: text, values, and compound. This includes adjusting BuildEnhanceDescVars in Lua to set variable sets accordingly, improving localization with templated variables, addressing percent calculations, and ensuring the proper flow between raw config data, overrides, and display strings. I’m also considering implications for related files and noting the need to recompile Panorama JS after changes.

- I only edited the Panorama source JS in `content`. You’ll need to rebuild/compile Panorama to update the generated `game/dzsj/panorama/...` outputs.

if Shop1Manager == nil then
    Shop1Manager = class({})
end

Shop1Managers = {}

Shop1Manager._event_registered = Shop1Manager._event_registered or false

Shop1Managers.debug = Shop1Managers.debug or false
Shop1Managers.motion_debug = Shop1Managers.motion_debug or false

Shop1Managers.level_map = { [1] = 1, [2] = 6, [3] = 12, [4] = 18, [5] = 24, [6] = 30 }
require("spawn_wall_manager")

function Shop1Managers:InitPlayer(pid)
    local mgr
    if not Shop1Managers[pid] then
        mgr = Shop1Manager()
        mgr.pid = pid
        Shop1Managers[pid] = mgr
    end

    mgr = Shop1Managers[pid]


    if not mgr.Slots then
        mgr.Slots = {}
    end

    for key, entindex in pairs(GameState.spawn_points[pid].good) do
        mgr.Slots[key] = -1
    end


    mgr:Start()
end

function Shop1Manager:Start()
    local raw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/shop config/shop1.txt")

    if not raw then
        return
    end

    -- 兼容两种写法："ShopItems" 根 或者直接是条目
    local kv = raw.ShopItems or raw

    self:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self:BuildEquipPool()
    self:RegisterShopEvents()
    self:SyncToClient()
end

function Shop1Manager:LoadShopItems(kv)
    self.items = {}

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for idStr, data in pairs(kv) do
        local id = tonumber(idStr)
        if id then
            local base_price   = tonumber(data.price) or 0
            local price_factor = tonumber(data.price_factor) or 1.0
            local unlock_delay = tonumber(data.unlock_time) or 0
            local grade        = tonumber(data.grade) or 1
            local name         = data.name or ""

            local price_table  = {}
            if data.price_table then
                for key, value in pairs(data.price_table) do
                    price_table[tonumber(key)] = tonumber(value)
                end
            end

            self.items[id] = {
                base_price   = base_price,         -- 初始价格
                price_factor = price_factor,       -- 价格倍率
                unlock_time  = now + unlock_delay, -- 解锁时间
                unlock_delay = unlock_delay,
                grade        = grade,              -- 商品等级（装备等级）
                buy_count    = 0,                  -- 已购买次数
                name         = name,
                price_table  = price_table
            }
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:BuildEquipPool()
    self.equip_pool = {}

    local added = {}

    if AbilityKV then
        for name, data in pairs(AbilityKV) do
            if type(data) == "table"
                and data.Shop == 1
                and data.Open == 1 then
                if not added[name] then
                    table.insert(self.equip_pool, name)
                    added[name] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RegisterShopEvents()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop_buy_request",
        function(_, keys) self:OnBuyRequest(keys) end
    )
    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener(
        "shop1_click_select",
        function(_, keys) self:OnClickSelect(keys) end
    )
end

function Shop1Managers:DebugLog(...)
    if self.debug then
        print("[Shop1Manager]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:MotionLog(...)
    if self.motion_debug then
        print("[Shop1Motion]", ...)
    end
end

function Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(lvl)
    return self.level_map[lvl] or 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 当前价格（带购买次数和倍率）
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    id = tonumber(id)
    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg or not cfg.price_table then return 0 end

    local count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
    if count < 1 then count = 1 end

    local price = cfg.price_table[count]
    if price == nil then
        local max_count = 0
        for key, _ in pairs(cfg.price_table) do
            if key > max_count then
                max_count = key
            end
        end
        price = cfg.price_table[max_count] or cfg.base_price or 0
    end

    return math.floor(price)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 同步数据到客户端 UI
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:SyncToClient()
    local data_items = {}

    for id, cfg in pairs(self.items) do
        data_items[id] = {
            price        = self:GetCurrentPrice(id),
            unlock_time  = cfg.unlock_time,
            unlock_delay = cfg.unlock_delay,
            grade        = cfg.grade,     -- 商品等级（装备等级）
            level        = cfg.buy_count, -- 用作 UI 显示“购买次数”的话
            name         = cfg.name,
        }
    end

    local data = { items = data_items }
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.GetClientState then
        data.enhance = Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(self.pid)
    end

    local pid = self.pid

    if pid then
        local p = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
        if p then
            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(p, "shop_data_update", data)
        end
        return
    end

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("shop_data_update", data)
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- 购买请求
---------------------------------------------------------
function Shop1Manager:OnBuyRequest(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end

    local id = tonumber(keys.id)

    if not id then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: invalid id", keys.id)
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then return end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then return end

    local cfg = self.items[id]
    if not cfg then
        print("[Shop] ERROR: no config for id", id)
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 解锁时间检查
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    if now < cfg.unlock_time then
        print("[Shop] id", id, "not unlocked yet")
        return
    end

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 金币检查 & 扣费
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local price = self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    local gold  = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")

    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)

    cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 随机一件装备
    -----------------------------------------------------
    if #self.equip_pool == 0 then
        print("[Shop] WARNING: equip_pool is empty")
        return
    end

    local equip_name = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 装备等级 = 商品等级（从配置拿，不再依赖 JS 传）
    -----------------------------------------------------
    local grade = cfg.grade or 1
    grade = math.max(1, math.min(6, grade))
    local lvl = tonumber(grade)

    self:AddItem(hero, equip_name, lvl, nil, true)

    -----------------------------------------------------
    -- 同步 UI & 日志
    -----------------------------------------------------
    self:SyncToClient()

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop_buy_success", {
        id    = id,
        level = cfg.buy_count, -- UI 如果还在显示 level，就当作“购买次数”
    })

    -- print(string.format(
    --     "[Shop] Player %d bought slot %d -> %s (grade=%d, price=%d, next_price=%d)",
    --     pid, id, equip_name, grade, price, self:GetCurrentPrice(id)
    -- ))
end

function Shop1Manager:OnClickSelect(keys)
    local pid = keys.PlayerID
    if self.pid ~= pid then
        return
    end
    local x = tonumber(keys.x)
    local y = tonumber(keys.y)
    local z = tonumber(keys.z) or 0
    if not x or not y then
        return
    end
    local pos = Vector(x, y, z)
    self:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, 125)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemRandomly(hero, lvl)
    local equipName = self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)]

    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, lvl)
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItem(hero, name, lvl, slot, count_recruit)
    local empty_slots = {}

    if not slot then
        for key, entindex in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if entindex == -1 then
                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end
        end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then
            return
        end

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
        slot = empty_slots[random]
    end

    if not slot then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, no slot", name, lvl)
        return
    end

    if not name or name == "" then
        Shop1Managers:DebugLog("AddItem skipped, invalid name", name, "slot", slot)
        return
    end

    name = "item_invoker_deafening_blast"

    local final_name = name .. "_" .. lvl
    local ab = hero:FindAbilityByName(final_name)
    if not ab then
        ab = hero:AddAbility(final_name)
    end

    local was_empty = self.Slots and self.Slots[slot] == -1
    if ab then
        ab.raw_name = name
        ab:AddInstance_Shop1({
            level = lvl,
            pid = self.pid,
            slot = slot,
        })
        if count_recruit and was_empty then
            SpawnWallManager:OnShop1DummyRecruited(self.pid, hero)
        end
        if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnItemAcquired then
            local changed = Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(self.pid, name, lvl)
            if changed and self.SyncToClient then
                self:SyncToClient()
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RefreshItemsForEnhance()
    local pid = self.pid
    if not pid then
        return
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end

    local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
    if not hero then
        return
    end

    local items = {}
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local raw_name = self:GetRawNameFromData(data)
            local level = self:GetDataLevel(data)
            if raw_name and level then
                table.insert(items, {
                    slot = slot,
                    raw_name = raw_name,
                    level = level,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:RemoveItem(item.slot)
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        self:AddItem(hero, item.raw_name, item.level, item.slot, false)
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:FindSlotByDummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end
    dummy = self:ResolveShop1Dummy(dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return nil end

    local dummyIndex = dummy:GetEntityIndex()
    for slot, data in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if data and data ~= -1 and data.Dummy == dummyIndex then
            return slot, data
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Shop1Manager:SelectNearestDummyByPos(pos, radius)
    if not pos then return end
    local bestEnt = nil
    local bestDist = nil
    for _, data in pairs(self.Slots or {}) do
        if data and data ~= -1 then
            local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                local selectEnt = dummy
                local proxyIndex = dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy
                if proxyIndex then
                    local proxy = EntIndexToHScript(proxyIndex)
                    if proxy and not proxy:IsNull() then
                        selectEnt = proxy
                    end
                end
                local dpos = selectEnt:GetAbsOrigin()
                local dist = (dpos - pos):Length2D()
                if dist <= radius and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestEnt = selectEnt
                end
            end
        end

function Shop1Manager:GetMaxDragDistance()
    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good
    if not points then return nil end

    local positions = {}
    for _, pos in pairs(points) do
        table.insert(positions, pos)
    end

    local maxDist = 0
    for i = 1, #positions do
        for j = i + 1, #positions do
            local dist = (positions[i] - positions[j]):Length2D()
            if dist > maxDist then
                maxDist = dist
            end
        end
    end

    return maxDist
end

function Shop1Manager:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(data)

function Shop1Manager:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not dataA or not dataB then return false end
    if dataA.Moving or dataB.Moving then return false end

    local levelA = self:GetDataLevel(dataA)
    local levelB = self:GetDataLevel(dataB)
    if not levelA or not levelB or levelA ~= levelB then return false end
    if levelA >= 6 then return false end

    local nameA = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataA)
    local nameB = self:GetDummyUnitName(dataB)
    if not nameA or not nameB or nameA ~= nameB then return false end

    return true, levelA
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB, targetSlot)
    if not slotA or not slotB then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotA]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotB]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    local ok, level = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
    if not ok then return false end

    if not targetSlot then
        local slotsRemoved = { slotA, slotB }
        targetSlot = slotsRemoved[RandomInt(1, #slotsRemoved)]
    end

    local equipName = (#self.equip_pool > 0) and self.equip_pool[RandomInt(1, #self.equip_pool)] or nil

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
    local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil

    self:RemoveItem(slotA)
    self.Slots[slotA] = -1

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
        self:RemoveItem(slotB)
        self.Slots[slotB] = -1

        local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
        local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
        if hero then
            if equipName then
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no equipName", slotA, slotB)
            end
        else
            Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize immediate failed, no hero", slotA, slotB)
        end
    end)

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slotMover, slotTarget, targetSlot, moveBoth)
    if not slotMover or not slotTarget then return false end

    local dataA = self.Slots[slotMover]
    local dataB = self.Slots[slotTarget]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 or not dataB or dataB == -1 then return false end

    if not targetSlot then

    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataA)
    self:PrepareDummyForSynthesize(dataB)

    local motion = self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local function ResolveSlotByData(findData)
        for slot, v in pairs(self.Slots) do
            if v == findData then
                return slot
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local done = 0
    local expected = moveBoth and 2 or 1
    local function finishOne()
        done = done + 1
        if done < expected then return end

        local slotA = ResolveSlotByData(dataA) or slotMover
        local slotB = ResolveSlotByData(dataB) or slotTarget

        local entA = dataA and dataA.Dummy or nil
        local entB = dataB and dataB.Dummy or nil
        print(string.format("[SYN][Animated] source=Animated pid=%s slotA=%s slotB=%s target=%s lvl=%s entA=%s entB=%s time=%.3f",

        self:RemoveItem(slotA)
        self.Slots[slotA] = -1

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
            self:RemoveItem(slotB)
            self.Slots[slotB] = -1

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(self.pid)
            local hero = (player and player:GetAssignedHero()) or self:GetHeroFromData(dataA)
            if hero then
                if equipName then
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated add", equipName, "lvl", level + 1, "slot", targetSlot)
                    self:AddItem(hero, equipName, level + 1, targetSlot)
                else
                    Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no equipName", slotMover, slotTarget)
                end
            else
                Shop1Managers:DebugLog("Synthesize animated failed, no hero", slotMover, slotTarget)
            end
        end)
    end

    self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataA, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    if moveBoth then
        self:AnimateDataToSlot(dataB, targetSlot, motion, finishOne)
    end

    return true
end

function Shop1Manager:AnimateDataToPos(data, targetPos, params, onFinish)
    if not data or not targetPos then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local dummy_sp = data.Autocast and data.Autocast.dummy_sp or nil

    params = params or self:GetDragMotionParams()
    local maxDuration = tonumber(params.max_duration) or tonumber(params.duration) or 1.0
    local minDuration = tonumber(params.min_duration) or 0
    local maxHeight = tonumber(params.max_height) or tonumber(params.height) or 200
    local steps = tonumber(params.steps) or 30
    local snapDistance = tonumber(params.snap_distance) or 0
    local maxDistance = tonumber(params.max_distance)
    if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = self:GetMaxDragDistance() or 0
    end
    if steps < 1 then steps = 1 end

    local startPos = dummy:GetAbsOrigin()
    local dist = (targetPos - startPos):Length2D()
    if dist <= snapDistance then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    if maxDistance <= 0 then
        maxDistance = dist
    end

    local distanceScale = math.min(dist / maxDistance, 1)
    local duration = maxDuration * distanceScale
    if duration < minDuration then
        duration = minDuration
    end
    if duration <= 0.03 then
        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(targetPos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(targetPos)
            main_pos = targetPos
        end
        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or targetPos)
        end
        if onFinish then onFinish() end
        return
    end

    local stepCount = math.floor(steps * (duration / maxDuration))
    if stepCount < 1 then stepCount = 1 end
    local height = maxHeight * distanceScale

    Shop1Managers:MotionLog("Move", string.format("dist=%.1f", dist), string.format("scale=%.2f", distanceScale),
        string.format("dur=%.2f", duration), string.format("height=%.1f", height), "steps", stepCount)

    local step = 0
    local interval = duration / stepCount

    data.Moving = true

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        local t = step / stepCount
        if t > 1 then t = 1 end

        local base = startPos + (targetPos - startPos) * t
        local z = startPos.z + (targetPos.z - startPos.z) * t + height * math.sin(math.pi * t)
        local pos = Vector(base.x, base.y, z)

        local main_pos = nil
        if data.Autocast and data.Autocast.UpdateFormationAtPos then
            main_pos = data.Autocast:UpdateFormationAtPos(pos)
        else
            dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
            main_pos = pos
        end
        if GoodForward then
            dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end

        if dummy_sp and not dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            dummy_sp:SetAbsOrigin(main_pos or pos)
        end

        if t >= 1 then
            data.Moving = false
            if onFinish then onFinish() end
            return
        end

        step = step + 1
        return interval
    end)
end

    local points = GameState.spawn_points[self.pid] and GameState.spawn_points[self.pid].good

    local nearestSlot = nil

function Shop1Manager:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(currentSlot, targetPos, radius)
    if not currentSlot or not targetPos then return nil end

    local dataA = self.Slots[currentSlot]
    if not dataA or dataA == -1 then return nil end

    local maxDist = radius or 200
    local bestSlot = nil
    local bestDist = nil

    for slot, dataB in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if slot ~= currentSlot and dataB and dataB ~= -1 then
            local dummy = dataB.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(dataB.Dummy)
            local pos = (dummy and not dummy:IsNull()) and dummy:GetAbsOrigin() or self:GetGoodPointPos(slot)
            if pos then
                local dist = (pos - targetPos):Length2D()
                if dist <= maxDist then
                    local ok = self:CanSynthesizePair(dataA, dataB)
                    if ok and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
                        bestDist = dist
                        bestSlot = slot
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestSlot
end

function Shop1Manager:AddItemLevel(hero, lvl)
    if not self.Slots then
        return
    end

    if next(self.Slots) == nil then
        return
    end

    for slot, value in pairs(self.Slots) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local stats = value.Stats

            if not stats then
                goto continue
            end

            if stats:IsNull() then
                goto continue
            end

            local level = stats.custom_level + (lvl or 1)

            if level > 6 then
                return
            end

            local ability = stats:GetAbility()
            if not ability then
                goto continue
            end

            local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
            local raw_name = StripTrailingIndex(name)

            self:RemoveItem(slot)
            self:AddItem(hero, raw_name, level, slot)

            return
        end
        ::continue::
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:Synthesize(hero)
    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then return end

    local slots = self.Slots
    local slotInfos = {}

    for slot, data in pairs(slots) do
        if data and data.Autocast ~= -1 then
            local autocast = data.Autocast
            if autocast and autocast.custom_level and autocast.custom_level < 6 then
                local lv = autocast.custom_level
                local unitName = self:GetDummyUnitName(data)
                if unitName then
                    slotInfos[lv] = slotInfos[lv] or {}
                    slotInfos[lv][unitName] = slotInfos[lv][unitName] or {}
                    table.insert(slotInfos[lv][unitName], slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, nameMap in pairs(slotInfos) do
        for _, points in pairs(nameMap) do
            while #points >= 2 do
                local slotA = table.remove(points)
                local slotB = table.remove(points)
                self:SynthesizePairSlotsImmediate(slotA, slotB)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1Manager:RemoveItem(slot)
    local data = self.Slots[slot]
    if not data or data == -1 then
        self.Slots[slot] = -1
        return
    end
    local dummy_name = self:GetDummyUnitName(data) or "nil"
    local dummy_ent = data and data.Dummy or nil
    local stats = data and data.Stats or nil
    local autocast = data and data.Autocast or nil
    local stats_id = tostring(stats)
    local autocast_id = tostring(autocast)
    local level = self:GetDataLevel(data) or "nil"
    self.Slots[slot] = -1

    local dummy = data.Dummy and EntIndexToHScript(data.Dummy) or nil
    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
        dummy.__autocast_destroying = true
        if WorldPanels and WorldPanels.DeletePanelsForEntity then
            WorldPanels:DeletePanelsForEntity(dummy)
        end
        if self.pid and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.GetSelectedEntities then
            local selected = PlayerResource:GetSelectedEntities(self.pid) or {}
            for _, ent in pairs(selected) do
                if ent == data.Dummy and PlayerResource.ResetSelection then
                    PlayerResource:ResetSelection(self.pid)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        ExecuteOrderFromTable({
            UnitIndex = dummy:entindex(),
            OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_STOP,
            Queue = false,
        })
        local mod = dummy:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        if mod then
            mod.is_paused = true
        end
        if dummy.Stop then
            dummy:Stop()
        end
        if dummy.SetForceAttackTarget then
            dummy:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
        end
    end

    if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
        autocast.is_paused = true
        local parent = autocast:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() then
            if parent.Stop then
                parent:Stop()
            end
            if parent.SetForceAttackTarget then
                parent:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
            end
        end
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
        if stats and not stats:IsNull() then
            stats:Destroy()
        end
        if autocast and not autocast:IsNull() then
            autocast:Destroy()
        end
        return nil
    end)
end
